description.value: Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub is Canada's first purpose-built gastro brewpub, crafting beer on the Victoria waterfront since 1984 with views of the Inner Harbour. The site combines a pub-style restaurant, taproom, a covered and heated outdoor patio, and heritage guesthouses, all supported by house-brewed ales, ciders, and sours made with local ingredients. Touring cyclists can fuel up on locally-sourced seasonal fare and pick up growler fills from the on-site provisions store.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Spinnakers is an active gastro brewpub and guesthouse at 308 Catherine Street, Victoria — OSM phone (250-386-2739) and email (spinnakers@spinnakers.com) match the contact page exactly. The brewery/taproom page describes a covered and heated waterfront patio, full food and drink service, and growler fills, but neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, or washrooms explicitly. No evidence was found for bike racks, Wi-Fi, charging, or most optional amenities, so those remain null per the evidence-only policy.
